author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A car struck a utility pole and a parked food truck on Route 138 in Taunton Tuesday afternoon, snapping the pole and leaving the vehicle on its side, according to witnesses and video from the scene.
WJAR reported that bystanders rushed to help the driver out of the car. The driver appeared disoriented and was taken to a hospital; authorities had not released an updated condition Tuesday evening.

The collision damaged Hetty’s Sweets Bakery and Savory Foods, a food truck that had opened only a week earlier. A co-owner told the station the business represented the owners’ life savings. No customers or workers were reported injured in the truck.

Neighbors said speeding has been a recurring concern along that section of Route 138, though police had not said what caused this crash. Investigators had not announced charges. The utility damage and the food truck’s losses were still being assessed, making the incident a developing local story rather than a final account.
dek: Witnesses helped the driver after a car hit a pole and the week-old Hetty’s Sweets Bakery and Savory Foods truck on Route 138.
headline: Taunton crash snaps utility pole and damages new food truck
